decisions.statement: Which property a key names is read from the index rather than from the key alone.
A key naming no relation is refused here.
A property naming members is a relation where a member is a relation.
The page types a value may name are the targets that property declares.
A value is resolved by the rule `relation-resolves` judges a landing by.
A value naming no page is refused before any body is worked out.
A value naming more than one page is refused.
The body is worked out by `change-page-property` rather than here.
No name reaching nothing survives here.
No page is taken away here.

definition: one relation a page states pointed at another page
